title: CBO Baseline Detail Common Field Definitions
description: Reusable definitions for processed CBO baseline-detail row fields.

program.description: Canonical CBO program name keyed by the stable source identifier.

category.description: Leaf line-item label from the source worksheet.

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year; null for every other period type.

value.description: Parsed numeric value from the source cell.

unit.description: Unit of measure for value, resolved from source labels and parse metadata.

source_file.description: Original CBO workbook filename in data/raw.

source_sheet.description: Worksheet name within the source workbook.

is_total.description: Whether the source category is an aggregate total or subtotal.

program_id.description: Stable numeric CBO identifier parsed from the source filename.

category_path.description: Full hierarchy-aware breadcrumb ending in category.

period_start_year.description: First year represented by the source period.

period_end_year.description: Last year represented by the source period.

period_label.description: Normalized source period label, such as 2026 or 2026-2030.

source_row.description: One-based worksheet row containing the numeric source value.

source_column.description: One-based worksheet column containing the numeric source value.

table_title.description: Top-level USDA source table heading containing the observation.

section.description: First intermediate USDA heading; empty when none exists.

subsection.description: Remaining intermediate USDA headings joined with ' / '.
